title: GRAHAM MERCER // WEEK 1 INFORMATION RESEARCH LEDGER
purpose: Preserve the information searches and evidence that justify Graham power-rating or matchup-number changes before market comparison.

policy.marketIsolation: Research and Graham-number changes are completed before contemporaneous Pinnacle comparison is exposed.
policy.noForcedMove: A sweep may record NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE. Daily review does not require daily rating movement.
policy.sourceRule: Material changes require traceable current sources. Clubhouse context alone is never enough to move a number.
policy.correctionRule: Correct a bad entry by appending a CORRECTION sweep; do not rewrite prior research history.

scheduledCadence.scope: Full 32-team post-MNF review, ESPN FPI comparison, personnel/injury/roster/coaching review, and complete independent Week numbers.
Current injury, practice, roster, QB, OL, defense, coaching and other material team information; move only affected ratings/numbers.
Weekend confirmation of material personnel and matchup information.
Early final information check before the 10:00 PT NFL window.
Change-only check since the most recent main sweep; do not repeat the full investigation unless new information warrants it.
